about: The path map `tests/suite.py --changed [BASE]` selects test modules by (SPD-234).
Every path changed against the merge base of BASE and HEAD, tracked or untracked and not ignored, is matched against
`full` first and then against each rule in order, the first match deciding; a pattern is an fnmatch pattern over the
path from the repository root, and its `*` crosses `/`.  A path in `full`, or in no rule at all, runs the full suite.
A rule's `modules` are test module names or fnmatch patterns over them (`test_hooks*` takes every module SPD-231
split tests/test_hooks.py into), expanded against the tree the run covers.  With `importers`, the rule also runs
the changed file's own module when it is a test module, and every test module that imports it, directly or through
another, read from the tree's import statements.
A rule with a `table` chooses from the dependency table instead (SPD-233): tests/suite_deps.json records, for each test
module, the files under bin/ whose functions it ran and the files under bin/ and share/ it read, measured by
tests/suite_deps.py, and what the per-process fixture's `spud init` ran or read.  A changed file the table never saw
runs the full suite; so does one whose reach -- the file and every module of bin/spudlib that reads its data, a
table, a constant or a class, directly or through another, read from the tree the run covers -- meets the fixture's;
else every test module whose entry meets the reach runs, and every test module the table does not name.  The table
records the digest of the bin/ and share/ it was measured on, and a run on a tree whose bin/ and share/ differ warns
that the selection may be short.  Widen this map by measuring again (tests/suite_deps.py), never by guess.
